page_title: Ragdoll Mail: the free mail app your AI agent can use, for Mac and Windows

sources.entry: Ragdoll Mail - Open-source IMAP mail client with instant local full-text search and a command line for scripts and AI agents. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/erict16/ragdoll-mail) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]

summary.name: Ragdoll Mail
summary.one_liner: A free, open-source desktop mail app for Mac and Windows with a built-in command line that lets AI agents search mail and draft replies, with the user approving every send.
use_cases: Letting an AI agent search your mail and write draft replies
Searching a large IMAP inbox quickly with local full-text search
Reading and managing mail from a desktop app on Mac or Windows
Scripting mail tasks through a JSON command-line interface
Using a non-Gmail or non-Outlook IMAP mailbox such as Tencent Exmail or QQ Mail
summary.what_it_does: Ragdoll Mail is a desktop mail client for Mac and Windows that connects to any IMAP mailbox over plain IMAP and SMTP. It includes a ragdoll command-line tool, installable from Settings, whose commands support --json output so AI agents such as Claude Code or Codex can search mail and write drafts. Drafts are saved to the Drafts folder with the signature and quoted thread, and pre-send checks flag issues like an empty subject, a missing attachment, or a leftover placeholder such as [Name]. Search runs against a local SQLite index on the user's computer, and the page says the send command refuses to run without an explicit confirmation.
notable: Built-in ragdoll CLI with --json output so agents can learn commands from --help
Local SQLite full-text search; mail talks only to the user's own mail server
Works with any IMAP mailbox without an OAuth app or API key
MIT-licensed open source with no ads or subscription
caveats: Not yet signed by Apple or Microsoft, so the first launch requires Open Anyway or Run anyway
Works with IMAP/SMTP mailboxes; the page does not list other protocols
Search timing figures are from a single test on one Tencent Exmail inbox
